title: VTR Effects Loki Modulation

controlChangeCommands.name: Algorithm
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Gate CC for CC9 (Figure). Values 0–8 = Gold Series nine algorithms in product order; older docs used CC2 1–6 for Chorus–HarmWave only. Diamond/Spade (CC3/CC5) labels change per algorithm on the display.

controlChangeCommands.name: Bar 1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Mode-dependent (Diamond). Exact label shown on OLED per algorithm; factory MIDI table does not rename per mode.

controlChangeCommands.name: Rate
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Bar 2 / Clubs — rate across timed algorithms.

controlChangeCommands.name: Depth
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Bar 3 / Spade — depth; OLED label may change per algorithm.

controlChangeCommands.name: Preset Up
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Value 0 advances preset (1→2…→99). Steps the 99 stored presets, not the queue order.

controlChangeCommands.name: Preset Dn
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Any value steps previous preset among the 99 stored presets.

controlChangeCommands.name: Figure
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0–31 quarter, 32–63 eighth, 64–95 dotted eighth, 96–127 triplet. No effect in Octave or Envelope.

additionalInfo: VTR Effects Loki MIDI table (PT). All VTR Effects MIDI TRS is Type B. CC2 Algorithm is the variant gate; CC9 Figure is no-op for Octave/Envelope.
